note: A small, hand-curated set of real Auslan signs sourced from MM-WLAuslan for this Newton's Second Law prototype. FORCE and MASS are deliberately NOT included: no confident physics-register match was found in the source dictionary (only the general 'coercion/force' and 'pile/church-mass' senses exist), so the app falls back to captions-only for those two concepts rather than show a misleading sign.

entries.extractionMethod: MediaPipe Holistic 0.10.21 (body + face + both hands) via pose_format.utils.holistic.load_holistic
entries.linguisticCaveat: This is the general/everyday sense of 'accelerator/accelerate' (e.g. a car's accelerator). It has not been confirmed by a fluent Auslan signer as the register a Deaf physics educator would use for the physics quantity 'acceleration'.
